Question: What are your thoughts on the breaking news that the Federal appeals court rules Trump doesn't have broad immunity from prosecution?
Answer: I don't want to appear ungrateful but……… WTF took so long! While I'm not a lawyer, this is a simple example of an open and shut case that could have been settled over lunch. They needed to write a 57 page opinion? Okay, take the rest of the weekend. I don't understand why such a frivolous appeal took an entire month to resolve. Now the March 4th trial date will have to be moved to late April or May with the possibility of more appeals to come. Trump wins even when he loses. Hopefully this opinion that took a month to write is airtight enough for the Supreme Court to decline taking up another appeal.
